DECISION
DECISION: Worker idle state is only set when Claude Code explicitly fires Stop or Notification hooks — not on post-tool-use, not by client-side timeout timer.
OPTIONS CONSIDERED:
1. Set idle on post-tool-use (old broken behavior — caused flicker between rapid tool calls)
2. Client-side 3-5s timer (also wrong — subagents run for minutes, main session shows idle incorrectly)
3. Stop hook only (correct — Claude is actually waiting for user input)
REASONING: If Claude is working, worker should show working. Post-tool-use fires between EVERY tool call in a chain. Stop hook only fires when Claude truly finishes and waits for user. Notification hook fires when Claude asks user something (also a 'waiting' state).
REVISIT WHEN: If users want to see agents go idle during very long Agent tool calls (subagents running 5+ minutes). Currently the main session worker stays active during subagents.

WHERE: src/app/api/hooks/post-tool-use/route.ts (don't set idle), src/app/api/hooks/stop/route.ts (set idle), src/app/api/hooks/notification/route.ts (set idle)
GOTCHA: worker-entity.ts had a client-side 5s idle timer — removed entirely.
